facts.text: A Vesper for me, and a light meal before the card game. The buy in is steep enough.
facts.why: Bond never says this. At the bar he is asked 'Shaken or stirred?' and answers with the line on the Bond drinks page. It is printed in quote marks as his words.
facts.fix: Do I look like I give a damn?
